manifest.name: cache-sentinel
manifest.description: DSH host plugin that guards against uncached prompts: blocks sends (read-only) and/or archives sessions after the prompt cache likely expired.
manifest.author: AliceSaikawa

bundle.text:
# Archive sessions that have been idle longer than the configured threshold.
- insert:
    - id: cache-sentinel
      name: cache-sentinel
      config: {}

readme.text:
English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that prevents accidental sends to old sessions whose prompt cache has expired.

If you send a follow-up message to a session where some time has passed since the last response, the entire accumulated conversation history is billed at the regular uncached input rate. `cache-sentinel` monitors the time elapsed since the last response and prevents accidental sends by automatically blocking sends to old sessions or automatically archiving the sessions themselves.
For sessions where the prompt cache lifetime has passed, this plugin prevents accidental sends in two ways:

- **Input blocking (`block`)**: Keeps the session open and readable while stopping the messages you send to the model. Work the agent is already doing (tool runs, jobs, subagents, goals, reminders) keeps going. When you want to continue sending, you can allow just the next send using the button above the input box or the `/unlock` command.
- **Auto-archiving (`archive`)**: Automatically archives sessions that have not been updated for a while, hiding them from the sidebar so they cannot be opened.

You can switch at any time from the chat `/sentinel` command to `both` mode, which combines both (input blocking after 60 minutes, archiving after 24 hours), or `off` mode, which temporarily disables the feature.

1. Run the following single command.

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel
   ```

`web` is an example. Specify the profile name you actually use. cache-sentinel works only in profiles that include the Web app, such as `web` and `desktop` (see [Supported Versions and Environment](#supported-versions-and-environment)).

This installs the latest `main`. To pin a version, append a tag as `#v<version>` (for example, `github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel#v1.2.3`). Tags up to and including `v0.5.0` do not contain the built `lib/`, so they cannot be installed this way. You can also install by giving the URL of the `cache-sentinel.tgz` attached to a GitHub Release.

2. Restart DSH.

Plugin code is loaded when DSH starts, so a restart is required after adding it.

Example when running DSH as a systemd user service:

```sh
   systemctl --user restart deepseek-harness
   ```

- **Check installation**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web list cache-sentinel --depth 0
  ```
- **Update**: Run the same installation command again to re-add the latest version, and then **be sure to restart DSH** (toggling the plugin off and on before restarting will continue to use the old code loaded in the process).
- **Remove**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web remove cache-sentinel
  ```

| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `block` (default) | Blocks your sends once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last response (viewing is still allowed). Work the agent is already doing is not stopped. `/unlock` allows the next single send |
| `archive` | Automatically archives the session once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last update (hidden from the sidebar and cannot be opened) |
| `both` | Blocks input `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) after the last response, and automatically archives `archiveAfterMinutes` (default: 1440 minutes = 24 hours) after the last update |
| `off` | Neither blocks input nor archives sessions (`/sentinel` and `/unlock` commands remain available) |

- `/sentinel`: Shows the current effective mode and its source (set via `/sentinel` / set in YAML), thresholds, elapsed minutes since the last response in this session, and `dryRun` status.
- `/sentinel block` | `archive` | `both` | `off`: Switches the effective mode. It is saved to `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/profiles/<profile>/state.json` (per profile) and preserved across DSH restarts (takes precedence over `mode` in YAML).
- `/sentinel default`: Clears the mode saved via `/sentinel` and reverts to the `mode` setting in YAML.
The argument is optional. After you type `/sentinel ` in the input box, the choices are shown as placeholder text until you type an argument.

- Running `/unlock` in an expired session under input blocking (`block` / `both` mode) allows just the next send once. The permission expires after `unlockTtlMinutes` (default: 10 minutes).
- Once a model response (`step/end`) returns after unlocking, the permission has served its purpose and normal checks resume (since the session is not expired right after a response, you can continue the conversation naturally).
- Running it in a session that has not expired yet or has no model response yet does not record a permission and only displays the current elapsed time or status.

- **Display language**: Text follows your environment. The Host resolves it from `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, `LANG`, and the system locale, in that order; the official Web UI resolves it from the browser language (`navigator.languages`). English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese are supported, and unsupported languages fall back to English. Log output (lines prefixed with `[cache-sentinel]`) stays in Japanese.
- **When a send is blocked (both the official Web UI and M3E)**:
  - The conversation displays "Send blocked (N minutes since the last response, as the cache has likely expired)." and "You can allow the next single send with /unlock.", along with the discarded input text (up to 2000 characters per message), as a command result line. This line is placed outside the turn; in the official Web UI it appears as a top-level line you can read right after sending, without expanding a collapsed turn (how it looks in M3E has not been checked).
  - Other input that entered the same step as your send and was discarded with it (job completion notices, plugin reminders, and so on) is shown not as its model-facing text but as the one-line description its producer attached (`source.summary`), o

You can change the settings on the plugin's page in the Web UI (sidebar **Plugins** → **cache-sentinel**), or in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Omitted keys use their default values.

```yaml
- id: cache-sentinel
  config:
    mode: block               # block / archive / both / off (can be overridden with /sentinel)
    idleMinutes: 60           # threshold for input blocking (min); in archive mode, the archive threshold (min)

- The plugin page shows every key except `stateFile`. **Save** writes the values to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; values that are out of range or not integers cannot be saved.
- Changes take effect without restarting DSH. Keys other than `stateFile` are applied to the running plugin as they are (in-memory `/unlock` permissions are kept). Changing `stateFile` re-applies the plugin with the new settings, which clears in-memory `/unlock` permissions.
- Specifying unknown keys or values with invalid types or ranges results in an error.

- Evaluates before a step starts at the head of the `agent/pre-step` hook (`prepend: true`). Because it runs before automatic compaction (`dsh-compaction-basic`), a blocked step does not trigger a model call for automatic compaction either.
- Only the first step of a turn that contains your send (a message whose `source.kind` is `user`) is blocked. The following steps pass even after the cache has expired, and may be sent without the cache:
  - Later steps of the same turn, such as a job completion notification or a steer you send while the turn is running. The step after a tool run also belongs here, but it is normally not judged expired at all: the last response time is refreshed by the `step/end` written when the tool finishes (see [Limitations](#limitations)).
  - Turns that start without your send: background job completion notifications, messages and completion notices from subagents, automatic goal continuation, reminders, and webhooks (webhooks exist only in DSH 0.2.0-rc.2).
- When an expired step passes for one of these reasons, the reason is written to the log (see [Viewing Logs](#viewing-logs)).
- If your send enters the same step as other input (for example, a job compl

- Checks the session list when the plugin is enabled and every `checkIntervalSeconds` seconds thereafter.
- The last update time (`lastActivityAt`) is the maximum of the session log file (`session.v*.jsonl[.zstd]`) `mtime`, the timestamp of the last event in a loaded session, and the timestamp when the session was manually unarchived (or the creation time if none are available).
- Sessions that stopped updating before the baseline timestamp (`baselineAt`) when an archiving mode was first enabled are not archived by default (set `archiveExisting: true` to include them).
- Pinned sessions (when `skipPinned: true`), subagent sessions, and sessions with running work (turns, jobs, subagents, reminders) are excluded.
- Sessions that are manually unarchived get another grace period of the threshold duration from the time the unarchiving is detected.

- **Running several profiles at the same time**: `state.json` is stored per profile (`$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/profiles/<profile>/state.json`), so modes, `baselineAt`, and unarchiving records do not overwrite each other. When you upgrade from an earlier version, each profile copies the old `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json` on its first start (the old file is kept and not read again). Where the profile name is not available, the old file is used. The archive state, however, lives in DSH's shared `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` and cannot be split by a plugin: DSH reads it once at startup, never reloads it, and every write replaces the whole file. If two profiles run at the same time, archiving / unarchiving / pinning in one can therefore be lost by a write from the other. **If you use `archive` or `both`, enable it in only one profile at a time.**
- Because M3E does not load client bundles from other plugins, displaying the pre-send banner requires support on the M3E side (the in-conversation notice when blocked is displayed by the Host side alone).
- In subagent sessions, `/unlock` cannot be executed from the GUI. Messages from the parent agent are not blocked, but a messag

readme.section: Restart DSH After Updating the Plugin
readme.text: After re-adding a new version with `dsh plugin --profile web add ...`, **restart DSH** before enabling the plugin or changing its settings. Toggling the plugin off and on without restarting will reuse the old module remaining in the process.

Startup, blocks, expired steps that were let through, `/unlock` grants, mode changes, and archiving are output with a `[cache-sentinel]` prefix to stdout / stderr and the DSH logger.

Example for checking logs when running DSH as a systemd user service (`deepseek-harness`):

```sh
journalctl --user -u deepseek-harness | grep cache-sentinel
```

```sh
pnpm test          # unit tests (node --test)
pnpm run typecheck # type check (tsc --noEmit)
pnpm run build     # build (lib/index.js, lib/client.js)
```

Installing with `github:` does not build anything, so the built `lib/` is committed to the repository. When you change `src/`, run `pnpm run build` and commit `lib/` as well.

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs the same three commands on Linux and Windows for every push to `main` and every pull request, and also checks that the committed `lib/` matches the build output. Releases come from `.github/workflows/release.yml` on a `v*` tag push: the tag must match the `version` in `package.json`, and the built `cache-sentinel.tgz` is attached to the GitHub Release.

To build from source and install a local `.tgz`:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel.git
cd cache-sentinel
pnpm install
pnpm run build

`scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs` is a verification script for environments running DSH as the `deepseek-harness` user systemd service; it retrieves the token from the startup URL in the journal and calls DSH RPCs directly.

```sh
node scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs workspace/unarchiveSession '{"sessionId":"..."}'
node scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs --args commands/execute '{"agentId":"<sessionId>","line":"/unlock","submittedAttachments":[]}'
```

`scripts/dsh-compat.ts` checks whether the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages that cache-sentinel uses have changed between DSH versions. When a new DSH version is released, it compares each package against the verified version and reports `same` (no change, so it should stay compatible) / `diff` (files changed, so a human should read the diff) / `missing` (fetch failed).

```sh
node scripts/dsh-compat.ts /var/tmp/dsh-compat 0.2.1-rc.1 0.2.1-rc.2
```

The same check runs on GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/dsh-compat.yml`). Start it from Actions > DSH compat > Run workflow, with the base version and the versions to check (space-separated). Dist-tags such as `next` are resolved to the version of `@deepseek-ai/dsh`. The result appears in the job summary. The job fails only on `missing`; a `diff` still needs a human to read it. On pull requests that change the script or the workflow, it runs automatically on a pinned pair (`0.2.1-rc.1` and `0.2.1-alpha.5`).

See [docs/](docs/README.md) for design, specifications, and investigation details (all documents under `docs/` are in Japanese).

- [docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md): Overall specification (mode switching and input blocking)
- [docs/spec-ui.md](docs/spec-ui.md): UI display and status API specification
- [docs/archive-spec.md](docs/archive-spec.md): Archive mode specification
- [docs/spike.md](docs/spike.md): Investigation notes on DSH internal APIs

- **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: **0.2.0-rc.2 to 0.2.2-alpha.2** (including 0.2.1-alpha.1 to alpha.5 and 0.2.1-rc.4 / rc.5, excluding official 0.2.1)
  - The range is declared in `package.json` under `peerDependencies` (`"@deepseek-ai/dsh": ">=0.2.0-rc.2 <=0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-alpha.2"`). DSH checks it when a plugin is installed and when a profile starts. A DSH outside the range refuses the plugin, which then does not load; DSH itself keeps starting and reports the reason. To run it anyway you must grant an exact-version exemption for the plugin version and that DSH version in the profile's `compatibility.json` (`dsh plugin --profile <profile> allow-version cache-sentinel@<version> --dsh-version <DSH version> --accept-risk`). **Official 0.2.1 is outside the range**, because it is not released as of 2026-11-01. In version order 0.2.1 comes before 0.2.2-alpha.2, so the declaration lists 0.2.2-alpha.2 on its own (`|| 0.2.2-alpha.2`). This keeps official 0.2.1, any later 0.2.1 release candidate, and 0.2.2-alpha.0 / alpha.1 outside the range.
  - **0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.1**: verified on a real environment with DSH as released on npm (`web` profile, 2026-10-18): input blocking, `/unlock`,

[English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | 简体中文

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，用于防止误向提示缓存（Prompt Cache）已过期的旧会话发送消息。

如果距上次响应已过去一段时间，直接在同一会话中继续发送消息，累积的全部对话历史都会按无缓存的常规输入价格计费。`cache-sentinel` 会监控距最后一次响应的经过时间，通过自动阻止向旧会话发送消息，或自动归档会话本身来防止误发送。

针对已超过提示缓存有效时间的会话，本插件可通过以下 2 种方式防止误发送：

- **禁止输入（`block`）**：保持会话可打开和阅读，仅阻止你的发送。代理正在进行的工作（工具执行、作业、子代理、目标、提醒）不会被阻止。若希望继续发送，可通过输入框上方的按钮或 `/unlock` 命令仅允许下一次发送。
- **自动归档（`archive`）**：自动归档一段时间未更新的会话，将其从侧边栏隐藏并设为不可打开。

您可以随时在聊天输入框中通过 `/sentinel` 命令切换到结合两者的 `both` 模式（60 分钟后禁止输入，24 小时后归档），或暂时停用功能的 `off` 模式。

1. 执行以下 1 条命令。

```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel
   ```

`web` 为示例，请指定您实际使用的配置文件（profile）名称。cache-sentinel 仅在包含 Web 应用的配置文件（如 `web`、`desktop`）中运行（请参阅[支持版本与运行环境](#支持版本与运行环境)）。

此方式安装 `main` 的最新代码。如需固定版本，请在末尾以 `#v<版本>` 的形式附加标签（例如 `github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel#v1.2.3`）。`v0.5.0` 及更早的标签不包含已构建的 `lib/`，无法用此方式安装。也可以指定 GitHub Release 中附带的 `cache-sentinel.tgz` 的 URL 进行安装。

2. 重启 DSH。

插件代码会在 DSH 启动时加载，因此添加后需要重启。

作为 systemd 用户服务运行时的示例：

```sh
   systemctl --user restart deepseek-harness
   ```

- **确认安装**：
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web list cache-sentinel --depth 0
  ```
- **更新**：再次执行与安装相同的命令重新添加最新版本后，**请务必重启 DSH**（在重启前即使切换禁用→启用，进程内仍会继续使用旧代码）。
- **卸载**：
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web remove cache-sentinel
  ```

| 模式 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `block`（默认） | 距最后一次响应超过 `idleMinutes`（默认 60 分钟）后阻止用户的发送（仍可浏览）。不阻止代理正在进行的工作。用 `/unlock` 允许下 1 次发送 |
| `archive` | 距最后一次更新超过 `idleMinutes`（默认 60 分钟）后自动归档（从侧边栏隐藏且无法打开） |
| `both` | 距最后一次响应 `idleMinutes`（默认 60 分钟）后禁止输入，距最后一次更新 `archiveAfterMinutes`（默认 1440 分钟 = 24 小时）后自动归档 |
| `off` | 既不禁止输入也不归档（`/sentinel` 和 `/unlock` 命令仍可执行） |

可在聊天输入框中查看当前状态并切换模式。

- `/sentinel`：显示当前生效模式及其来源（通过 `/sentinel` 设置 / YAML 设置）、阈值、当前会话距最后一次响应的经过分钟数，以及 `dryRun` 状态。
- `/sentinel block` | `archive` | `both` | `off`：切换生效模式。保存在 `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/profiles/<配置文件>/state.json` 中（按配置文件分开），DSH 重启后依然保持（优先于 YAML 中的 `mode`）。
- `/sentinel default`：清除通过 `/sentinel` 保存的模式，恢复为 YAML 中的 `mode` 设置。

参数可选。在输入框中输入 `/sentinel ` 后，在输入参数之前，候选项会以占位文字的形式显示。

- 在因禁止输入（`block` / `both` 模式）而过期的会话中执行 `/unlock`，会仅允许下 1 次发送。该许可在 `unlockTtlMinutes`（默认 10 分钟）后失效。
- 获得许可后只要返回 1 次模型响应（`step/end`），许可即完成使命，之后恢复常规判定（刚收到响应时尚未过期，因此可以自然地继续对话）。
- 在尚未过期的会话或尚无模型响应的会话中执行时，不会记录许可，仅显示当前经过时间或状态。

- **显示语言**：界面文字跟随环境。Host 按 `LC_ALL`、`LC_MESSAGES`、`LANG`、系统区域设置的顺序判定，官方 Web UI 按浏览器语言（`navigator.languages`）判定。支持英语、日语和简体中文，未支持的语言回退为英语。日志输出（以 `[cache-sentinel]` 开头的行）仍为日语。
- **被阻止时（官方 Web UI 与 M3E 共通）**：
  - 会话内会以命令结果行的形式显示“已阻止发送(距最后一次响应 N 分钟，因为缓存很可能已过期)。”、“可用 /unlock 允许下 1 次发送。”，以及被丢弃的输入文本（每条最多 2000 字符）。该行位于轮次之外；在官方 Web UI 中，发送后无需展开折叠的轮次即可作为最顶层的行直接看到（M3E 中的显示效果尚未确认）。
  - 与用户发送进入同一步骤并一同被丢弃的其他输入（作业完成通知、插件的提醒等）不会显示面向模型的正文，而是显示来源附带的一行说明（`source.summary`），或“(来自 kind 的输入)”一行。
  - 重复发送相同输入而被连续阻止时，为避免通知堆积，每 10 分钟只显示 1 条（输入有变化或其间有发送成功时则立即显示）。阻止本身每次都会执行。
- **发送前的横幅显示**：
  - **官方 Web UI**：客户端插件（`lib/client.js`）会在输入框上方（`conversation.input.dock`）显示状态横幅。
    - 已过期：“缓存已过期(距最后一次响应 N 分钟)。直接发送将被阻止。”与“允许下 1 次发送(/unlock)”按钮
    - 允许中：“正允许下一次发送(将按无缓存价格计费)。剩余 M 分钟”
    - 如果按钮无法执行 `/unlock`，警告下方会显示原因。此时请在输入框中发送 `/unlock`。
  - **M3E（`dsh-webui-m3e`）**：被阻止时的会话内通知行可以显示，但由于 M3E 不会加载其他插件的客户端包，发送前的横幅显示需要 M3E 侧的支持。
- **与其他插件并用（如 rdsh-ui-comfort）**：
  - 启用把第 1 次 Enter 变为换行的插件（`rdsh-ui-comfort` 等）后，第 1 次 Enter 不会发送，只会插入换行。这是该插件对按键的处理方式，cache-sentinel 并未阻止输入。在短时间内（rdsh-ui-comfort 默认 1.5 秒内）再按一次 Enter 才会发送；若此时已过期，则会在服务端被阻止，并在会话内显示阻止通知。间隔较久后再按 Enter，只会再插入一个换行。
- **状态获取 API**：
  - `GET /api/cache-sentinel.status?se

可在 Web UI 的插件页面（侧边栏「插件」→「cache-sentinel」）或配置文件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中修改设置。省略的项将使用默认值。

```yaml
- id: cache-sentinel
  config:
    mode: block               # block / archive / both / off (可用 /sentinel 覆盖)
    idleMinutes: 60           # 禁止输入的阈值(分钟)。archive 模式下为归档阈值(分钟)

- 插件页面列出除 `stateFile` 以外的所有项。点击「保存」会写入配置文件的 `cordis.patch.yml`；超出范围或不是整数的值无法保存。
- 设置修改无需重启 DSH 即可生效。`stateFile` 以外的项会直接应用到正在运行的插件（内存中的 `/unlock` 许可会保留）。修改 `stateFile` 时插件会以新设置重新应用，内存中的 `/unlock` 许可会被清除。
- 指定未知键名或类型、范围无效的值时会报错。

- 在 `agent/pre-step` 钩子的最外层（`prepend: true`）于步骤开始前进行判定。由于在自动压缩（`dsh-compaction-basic`）之前判定，被阻止的步骤也不会因自动压缩而触发模型调用。
- 只阻止包含用户发送（`source.kind` 为 `user` 的消息）的轮次的第一个步骤。以下步骤即使缓存已过期也会放行，可能会在无缓存的情况下发送：
  - 同一轮次的第 2 个及之后的步骤（如轮次进行中到达的作业完成通知或插入发送）。工具执行后的后续步骤也属于此类，但最后响应时间会在工具结束时写入的 `step/end` 处更新，因此通常不会被判定为过期（参见[限制](#限制)）。
  - 不含用户发送而开始的轮次（后台作业完成通知、来自子代理的消息和完成通知、目标自动继续、提醒、webhook。webhook 仅存在于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2）。
- 因上述原因放行已过期的步骤时，会在日志中记录原因（参见[查看日志](#查看日志)）。
- 如果用户发送与其他输入（如正在等待的作业完成通知）进入同一步骤，则整个步骤都会被阻止，该输入也会被丢弃。
- 经过时间根据会话最后一次 `step/end` 事件的时间戳（包含从分叉继承的历史）计算。但对于子代理分叉出的子会话，不使用继承的历史，而是取子会话创建时间与其自身最后一次 `step/end` 中较晚的一个（因为这种分叉发生在父代理运行期间）。尚无模型响应的新会话，或经过时间恰好在 `idleMinutes` 分钟以内的会话会直接放行。
- 拒绝步骤时不会发出 API 请求，也不会产生费用。**原本准备进入该步骤的发送消息会被丢弃**，请在解除后重新输入（被丢弃的文本会显示在会话内的阻止通知中）。

- 在插件启用时以及之后每隔 `checkIntervalSeconds` 秒检查一次会话列表。
- 最后更新时间（`lastActivityAt`）取会话日志文件（`session.v*.jsonl[.zstd]`）的 `mtime`、已加载会话末尾事件的时间戳、手动取消归档的时间戳中的最大值（若均无则取创建时间）。
- 在首次启用归档模式的基准时间（`baselineAt`）之前就已停止更新的会话，默认不会归档（设置 `archiveExisting: true` 可将其纳入对象）。
- 已置顶的会话（当 `skipPinned: true` 时）、子代理会话，以及有正在执行的工作（轮次、作业、子代理、提醒）的会话不在对象范围内。
- 手动取消归档的会话，从检测到取消归档的时刻起会再次获得阈值时长的宽限期。

- **同时运行多个配置文件**：`state.json` 按配置文件分开保存（`$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/profiles/<配置文件>/state.json`），因此模式、`baselineAt` 和解除归档记录不会互相覆盖。从旧版本升级时，各配置文件在首次启动时会沿用原来的 `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json` 的内容（原文件不会被删除，之后也不再读取）。无法获取配置文件名的环境仍使用原来的文件。但归档状态保存在 DSH 的共享文件 `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` 中，插件无法将其分离：DSH 在启动时只读取一次，之后不再重新读取，每次写入都会替换整个文件。因此同时运行两个配置文件时，一方的归档 / 取消归档 / 置顶修改可能被另一方的写入覆盖而丢失。**如果使用 `archive` / `both`，请只在其中一个配置文件中启用。**
- 由于 M3E 不会加载其他插件的客户端包，发送前的横幅显示需要 M3E 侧的支持（被阻止时的会话内通知仅靠 Host 侧即可显示）。
- 在子代理会话中，无法从 GUI 执行 `/unlock`。来自父代理的消息不会被阻止，但从 GUI 直接发送给子代理的消息，在子代理一侧缓存已过期时会被阻止。
- 即使由用户操作产生，非普通发送的输入也不会被阻止：
  - 通过 `/goal <目标>` 创建目标、通过 `/goal edit` 编辑目标、恢复目标。即使缓存已过期，目标也会运行。
  - 带附件的 `/goal`。附件会作为普通发送先进入，因此会被阻止并丢弃，目标将在没有附件的情况下运行（根据代码得出的行为，未在实际环境中确认）。
  - 缓存过期后对提问（`ask_user_question`）的回答。如果阻止，回答会被丢弃。问题会恢复为等待回答的状态，但用户以为已经回答过，很难意识到需要重新回答。
- 超过 `idleMinutes` 的工具执行之后的后续步骤会在无缓存的情况下发送，但插件不会检测到（也不会记录日志）。这是因为最后响应时间会在工具结束时写入的 `step/end` 处更新。
- 标题自动生成（`session-title-first-prompt-llm`）会在首次发送时独立调用模型，不在门控对象范围内（仅限新会话或分叉的首次发送，且只发送第一条消息）。
- 提示缓存的实际寿命取决于提供方和请求内容。本插件仅根据经过时间进行近似判定。

readme.section: 更新插件后请重启 DSH
readme.text: 使用 `dsh plugin --profile web add ...` 重新添加新版本后，请在启用插件或修改设置之前**重启 DSH**。如果不重启而只是切换插件的禁用→启用，仍会复用进程内残留的旧模块。

启动、阻止、虽已过期但仍放行的步骤、`/unlock` 许可、模式变更和归档均会带 `[cache-sentinel]` 前缀输出到标准输出 / 标准错误以及 DSH 的日志器中。

作为 systemd 用户服务（`deepseek-harness`）运行时的日志查看示例：

```sh
journalctl --user -u deepseek-harness | grep cache-sentinel
```

```sh
pnpm test          # 单元测试 (node --test)
pnpm run typecheck # 类型检查 (tsc --noEmit)
pnpm run build     # 构建 (lib/index.js, lib/client.js)
```

通过 `github:` 安装时不会进行构建，因此仓库中也包含已构建的 `lib/`。修改 `src/` 后，请执行 `pnpm run build` 并一并提交 `lib/`。

推送到 `main` 和 pull request 时，CI（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`）会在 Linux 和 Windows 上执行相同的三条命令，并检查已提交的 `lib/` 与构建结果一致。发布通过推送 `v*` 标签进行（`.github/workflows/release.yml`）：标签名必须与 `package.json` 的 `version` 一致，否则会失败，构建出的 `cache-sentinel.tgz` 会附加到 GitHub Release。

从源码构建并安装本地 `.tgz` 时：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel.git
cd cache-sentinel
pnpm install
pnpm run build

`scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs` 是在将 DSH 作为 `deepseek-harness` 用户 systemd 服务运行的环境中，从 journal 的启动 URL 获取令牌并直接调用 DSH RPC 的验证脚本。

```sh
node scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs workspace/unarchiveSession '{"sessionId":"..."}'
node scripts/dsh-rpc.mjs --args commands/execute '{"agentId":"<sessionId>","line":"/unlock","submittedAttachments":[]}'
```

`scripts/dsh-compat.ts` 用于检查 cache-sentinel 所使用的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 各包是否因 DSH 版本而变化。发布新的 DSH 版本时，它会将各包与已确认的版本进行比较，并报告 `same`（无变化，预计兼容）/ `diff`（有变化，需要人工阅读差异）/ `missing`（获取失败）。

```sh
node scripts/dsh-compat.ts /var/tmp/dsh-compat 0.2.1-rc.1 0.2.1-rc.2
```

同样的检查也可以在 GitHub Actions 上运行（`.github/workflows/dsh-compat.yml`）。在 Actions > DSH compat > Run workflow 中指定基准版本和要比较的版本（以空格分隔）即可启动。`next` 等 dist-tag 会解析为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的版本。结果显示在作业摘要中。只有出现 `missing` 时作业才会失败；`diff` 仍需人工阅读判断。修改该脚本或工作流的 pull request 会自动以固定的版本组合（`0.2.1-rc.1` 与 `0.2.1-alpha.5`）运行。

设计、规格与调研详情请参阅 [docs/](docs/README.md)（`docs/` 下的文档均为日语）。

- [docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md)：总体规格（模式切换与禁止输入）
- [docs/spec-ui.md](docs/spec-ui.md)：UI 显示与状态 API 规格
- [docs/archive-spec.md](docs/archive-spec.md)：归档模式规格
- [docs/spike.md](docs/spike.md)：DSH 内部 API 调研记录

- **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**：**0.2.0-rc.2 ～ 0.2.2-alpha.2**（包含 0.2.1-alpha.1～alpha.5 和 0.2.1-rc.4、rc.5，不包含 0.2.1 正式版）
  - 支持范围在 `package.json` 的 `peerDependencies` 中声明（`"@deepseek-ai/dsh": ">=0.2.0-rc.2 <=0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-alpha.2"`）。DSH 会在添加插件时和启动配置文件时检查该范围。若 DSH 超出范围，插件会被拒绝而不会加载（DSH 本身仍会启动，并显示原因）。若确需运行，请在配置文件的 `compatibility.json` 中按插件版本与 DSH 版本的精确组合进行豁免（`dsh plugin --profile <配置文件> allow-version cache-sentinel@<版本> --dsh-version <DSH 版本> --accept-risk`）。**0.2.1 正式版不在范围内**（截至 2026-11-01 尚未发布）。按版本顺序 0.2.1 排在 0.2.2-alpha.2 之前，因此声明中单独列出 0.2.2-alpha.2（`|| 0.2.2-alpha.2`）。这样 0.2.1 正式版、之后可能发布的 0.2.1 rc 以及 0.2.2-alpha.0、alpha.1 都不在范围内。
  - **0.2.0-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.1**：已使用 npm 发布的 DSH 在真实环境确认（`web` 配置文件，2026-10-18）。确认的功能包括输入阻止、`/unlock`、`/sentinel`（不带参数时从输入框；带参数时仅通过 RPC 的 `commands/execute`，见 [#36](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel/issues/36)）、归档周期、对话中的阻止通知以及输入框上方的横幅。两个版本的结果相同。使用的 cache-sentinel 是 main 的 `86a77f6`，早于横幅按钮的修复（[#34](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel/pull/34)），因此按钮无法使用。修复后的按钮已在 0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.3 上确认。详情请参阅 [docs/dsh-version-check.md](docs/dsh-version-check.md)。
  - **0.2.1-rc.3**：已使用 npm 发布的 DSH 在真实环境确认（`web` 配置文件，2026-10-26）。确认的功能包括输入阻止、对话中的阻止通知
